record.geography_note: Location not established. Current record scope: Serbian-origin imports at disputed Kosovo–Serbia boundary. Coloured lines locate matching records; they are not approved phase geometry or the extent of a closure. Phase location approvals are recorded separately in the current workbook.

release_review.adjudication: Accept ten targeted findings with the Albanian legal-clock qualification, police-attributed Morine endpoint and unresolved sequence, and the Benapole ordinary-passenger onset correction. The stopped bus’s 11 February passengers crossed on foot; the passenger phase is dated 12–13 February. Retain the explicit 13 February resumption date at calendar-day precision despite the documented inconsistent weekday; do not claim 24 elapsed hours, reliable passenger counts or stable emergency access. Formula-target suggestions become recalculation expectations. This is not a full-record audit of these ten parents.
